content:
anya: Fresh org, followed the Node quickstart exactly. First call to /v1/chat returns 402 Payment Required even though the web UI shows workspace active. Anyone seen a billing gate that shows up only after the UI flow completes?

sam: Was the org created via SSO or the invite link?

anya: Invite link. Using a service account key in env (REDWOOD_KEY). Sample log attached below.

leo: Can you paste the exact curl and response headers? 402 responses usually include a billing_url in the body.

anya: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' 
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'

HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":{"type":"billing_required","message":"workspace payment required","billing_url":"https://app.redwood.ai/workspaces/abc123/billing"}}
```

sam: Did you set billing as team/paid or try the trial credits? There's a race we've seen where the UI marks the workspace as "onboarded" before the billing provisioning finishes for invite-created orgs.

marta: FWIW we saw a different quickstart quirk: the sample app under systemd reads REDWOOD_KEY from ~/.config/redwood instead of the env var, so folks get a stale key. Could be two separate things.

anya: Confirmed env present and printed in process env. Swapping to explicit --key flag in the sample fixed the 402 instantly. Strange. :thinking_face: 

leo: What SDK version is the sample using? There's an auth header parity issue: older SDKs used a "Token " prefix vs the newer "Bearer ". The API accepts Bearer; if the SDK sends Token the gateway rejects unless the workspace is fully provisioned.

anya: Node SDK 0.9.3 in the starter repo. The curl used Bearer above.

infra-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-89 onboarding-billing-delay — https://go.redwood.ai/inc/INC-2026-89

sam: Temporary workaround: visit the billing page for the workspace and confirm payment/trial (https://app.redwood.ai/workspaces/abc123/billing). We'll update the quickstart to check billing state before making the first outbound call so users see a clear message instead of a 402.

anya: Thanks — I added a local guard that checks /v1/workspaces/:id and surfaces a "needs billing" message. Now fails early with a human-friendly hint. I can open a PR for the quickstart.

marta: Filed issue in the starter repo with repro steps and a tiny patch suggestion: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter/issues/427 — suggests showing a modal/link before the sample issues the first request.

devex-bot: Merged PR #40321: quickstart: show billing-required message before first API call (cherry-picked to main).

anya: Closing out here — re-open if it pops up again. Huge help, thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
